units: Targ. Is. XXVIII, 15.—בְּגִין for the sake of, on account of; in order that.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 12:13">Targ. Y. Gen. XII, 13</cite> (O. <he>בדיל</he>).

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 18:24">Ib. XVIII, 24</cite>; a. fr.—[In Talm. h. a. ch.] <cite ref="Yevamot 89b:7">Yeb. 89ᵇ</cite> <he>אוכלת בְּגִינוֹ וכ׳</he> on his account (as his wife) she is permitted to eat T’rumah.

Y. B. Kam. X, 7ᶜ top בג׳ כן therefore; a. fr.—בגין ד׳ because, since. Y. Gitt. IX, 50ᵇ ב׳ דרב וכ׳ because Rab and Samuel, both of them, said. Y. Bicc. II, 64ᵈ top ב׳ דכתיב because it is so written; a. fr.
